description: I'm a Renewable Energy Engineering student at Mansoura University, passionate about space technology, solar energy, and engineering innovation. I'm developing MOONBASE: POWER SURVIVAL, a lunar energy management simulator. I have experience with Python, Streamlit, MATLAB, and Arduino. I'm looking for motivated teammates skilled in Python, UI/UX, 3D design, astronomy, or electrical engineering to turn ideas into reality!
summary:
MOONBASE: POWER SURVIVAL is an interactive simulation of an energy management system for a future lunar base. Built using Python and Streamlit, the project demonstrates how astronauts can manage limited electrical power generated by solar panels and stored in batteries.

Users can monitor power generation, battery levels, and the energy consumption of essential lunar base systems, including life support, thermal control, communications, lighting, and scientific equipment.

The project aims to demonstrate the importance of intelligent energy management in ensuring astronaut safety and mission continuity during challenging lunar conditions. It provides an educational and interactive way to explore the engineering challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon.
details:
MOONBASE: POWER SURVIVAL is an interactive educational simulation designed to demonstrate the challenges of managing electrical power in a sustainable lunar settlement.

The application simulates a lunar base powered by solar photovoltaic panels and supported by battery storage systems. It provides a visual dashboard where users can monitor the energy balance and manage different electrical loads.

The simulated systems include:

  • Life Support
  • Thermal Control
  • Communications
  • Lighting
  • Science Laboratory
  • ISRU Plant
  • Workshop
  • Comfort Systems

The main objective is to demonstrate how energy allocation and prioritization can affect the survival and operational continuity of a lunar base.

The project was developed using Python and Streamlit, with an interactive interface designed to make complex energy management concepts easier to understand.

Its creative approach combines renewable energy engineering with space exploration, highlighting the importance of reliable and intelligent energy management for future lunar missions.
